# Music Sheet Enhancer Skill

Transform degraded, blurry, or low-resolution photocopied music sheets into ultra-sharp vector scores, verified note-for-note against the original scan before delivery.

---

## 1. Core Delivery Principles (Mandatory Order)

1. **Clean 1:1 Restoration First (Default Mode — `--format clean`)**:
   - Always begin by recreating the **exact original document** faithfully into `dist/<slug>/` with **zero extra descriptions** (no Student Name/Date/Score fields, no mnemonic cheat sheets, no LH/RH commentary badges, and no extra underline blanks unless present in the original).
   - Preserve original title, clefs, noteheads, fingerings (`finger`), left-margin section numbers (`leftLabel`), and final double barlines (`endBarType: "end"`).
2. **Kids, Reference, or Enhanced Editions Strictly On-Demand**:
   - Only generate `--format kids` (`workbook` + `workbook-answers`), `--format clean-reference` (note letter names below each note), or `--format single` **after** the clean score is verified 100% accurate—or only when explicitly requested by the user.

---

## 2. Supported Formats & Layouts

| Format ID | Default? | Layout Characteristics | Use Case |
|:---|:---:|:---|:---|
| **`clean`** | **Yes** | 1:1 faithful A4 vector score (`690px` wide staves), serif title, original clefs/fingerings/margin labels/barlines, zero extra text. | Direct clean restoration of scanned sheet music. |
| **`clean-reference`** | No | Identical 1:1 score plus crisp aligned note letters (`C`–`B`) underneath each notehead and subtle Reference Key badge. | Answer / reading reference without workbook clutter. |
| **`kids`** (`workbook` + `workbook-answers`) | No | 4-page large-print kids workbook (`#1`..`#n` boxes, mnemonics, milestones) & paired answer key (pitch + solfège). | Young beginners, when requested by user. |
| **`single`** / **`single-answers`** | No | Compact 1-page practice worksheet with info bar, RH/LH labels, and underline blanks or blue answer pills. | Daily worksheet exercises, when requested. |
| **`all`** | No | Emits all 6 formats (`clean`, `clean-reference`, `workbook`, `workbook-answers`, `single`, `single-answers`). | Full suite / CI verification. |

---

## 3. Supported Languages & Culture Codes

Built-in dictionaries: `en`, `zh-TW`, `zh-HK`, `zh-CN`, plus BCP 47 auto-negotiation (`en-US`, `en-AU`, `zh-Hant`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-SG`, `zh-MO`) and custom `--locale-file <path>`.

---

## 4. Mandatory End-to-End Verification Loop

**NEVER trust a single blind pass on blurry scans.** Execute this closed loop before presenting final files to the user:

```
Extract & Crop from x=0 ──► Transcribe + Domain Math Check ──► Build Clean Output
        ▲                                                              │
        └────── Loop & Fix JSON until 100% match ◄── Visual 1:1 Compare PDF
                                                                       │
                                                                       ▼
                                             Final PDF Check ─► Tests ─► Cleanup Tmp ─► Report
```

### Step 1: High-Resolution Extraction & Full-Width Crop
Extract raw raster pages from the blurry PDF/photo, deskew tilted scans, and crop stave strips **starting at `x = 0`** (NEVER trim left clefs, margin labels, Note 1, or right end barlines):
```bash
node bin/verify.js --scan sheets/scan.pdf --angle -1.33 --out .verify-tmp
```
Inspect the extracted `stave_X_full.png` strips directly via your image viewer (split into zoomed overlapping horizontal slices if notes are dense).

### Step 2: Transcribe Dataset & Run Mathematical Checks
Author a JSON dataset following `data/schema.json` (prefer the document object schema `{ "title": "...", "stepwise": true, "exercises": [...] }` when restoring a named piece):
- Include `finger`, `leftLabel`, `endBarType`, and `expectedCount` per stave where applicable.
- For VexFlow 5 accuracy, always specify `{ "clef": "bass", ... }` on bass staves.
- Validate schema, counts, pitch ranges, and stepwise continuity (`±1` diatonic interval when `stepwise: true`):
```bash
node bin/verify.js --data data/my-piece.json --stepwise
```
**If any schema error, note-count mismatch, or unexpected interval jump appears, stop and re-check the cropped scan image before continuing.**

### Step 3: Render Clean Restoration & Stacked 1:1 Visual Comparison
Compile the clean sheet **and** a stacked 1:1 comparison PDF (raw scan strip on top, red-numbered VexFlow SVG + note letters below):
```bash
node bin/cli.js --data data/my-piece.json --out dist/my-piece --pdf
node bin/verify.js --data data/my-piece.json --scan sheets/scan.pdf --angle -1.33 --out .verify-tmp --compare
```
Inspect `.verify-tmp/compare_all.pdf` note-by-note from Stave 1 to the last stave.
**Repair Loop**: If even a single notehead position, clef, fingering, margin label, or end barline disagrees with the raw scan strip above it, fix `data/my-piece.json`, regenerate, and re-inspect `compare_all.pdf` until **100% exact**.

### Step 4: Inspect Final Deliverable PDF(s)
Visually inspect every generated file in `dist/my-piece/*.pdf`:
- Confirm zero overlaps between ledger lines, fingerings, note letters, and adjacent staves.
- Confirm generous horizontal spacing across the full page width and crisp single-page A4 fit.

### Step 5: Test, Clean Up Temp Files, and Report
```bash
npm test
node bin/verify.js --clean --out .verify-tmp
```
Ensure zero scratch scripts, temporary crops, or `compare_all.*` files remain in the repository. Only report verified note sequences, counts, test pass tallies, and clickable links to the clean `dist/<slug>/` outputs.

## 5. Programmatic API

```javascript
const {
  generateCleanSheetHtml,
  generateWorkbookHtml,
  generateSinglePageHtml,
  verifyNoteDataset,
  renderHtmlToPdf
} = require('music-sheet-enhancer');

const dataset = require('./data/note-step-on-staff.json');
const report = verifyNoteDataset(dataset);
if (!report.valid) throw new Error('Pitch verification failed');

const html = generateCleanSheetHtml({
  exercises: dataset,
  locale: 'en',
  isAnswerKey: false,
  standalone: true
});
renderHtmlToPdf('dist/clean.html', 'dist/clean.pdf');
```

## 🌟 Highlights & Features

- 🎼 **Faithful 1:1 Clean Restoration First (`clean`)**: Recreates blurry scans into crisp A4 VexFlow vector scores (`690px` wide staves) preserving original titles, fingerings, margin labels, and final double barlines — with **zero extra student headers, blanks, or descriptions**.
- 🔤 **Clean Reference Key (`clean-reference`)**: Adds crystal-clear blue note letter names below each notehead when a reading reference is requested.
- 👶 **On-Demand Kids Large-Print Workbook (`kids` / `workbook`)**: 4-page spacious layout featuring oversized staves (`135px`), `#1`..`#n` numbered answer boxes, mnemonic cards, and motivational milestone footers — generated only when requested.
- 📄 **Single-Page Worksheet (`single` / `single-answers`)**: Compact 1-page practice worksheet restoring 7 staves with underline blanks or answer pills.
- ✅ **Closed Verification Loop (`bin/verify.js`)**: Automated full-width (`x = 0`) scan extraction/deskewing, schema/count/stepwise (`±1`) mathematical checks, and stacked 1:1 raw-scan vs VexFlow comparison PDFs.
- 🌐 **Multi-Lingual & Extensible (i18n)**: `en`, `zh-TW`, `zh-HK`, `zh-CN` + BCP 47 negotiation & custom dictionaries (`--locale-file`).
- ⚡ **Offline & Standalone**: Emits 100% self-contained HTML files (embedded VexFlow) and direct A4 PDFs via Edge / Chrome / Chromium.
- 🤖 **Universal AI Agent Skill**: Includes [`skills/music-sheet-enhancer/SKILL.md`](skills/music-sheet-enhancer/SKILL.md) with the verified multi-stage self-checking loop for Antigravity, Claude Code, Kiro, Cursor, Copilot, and Codex.
- 🛡️ **Security Hardened**: HTML sanitization, strict note pitch grammar validation, `<script>` safe JSON escaping, and zero high-severity vulnerabilities.

## 🚀 Quick Start

### 1. Installation

```bash
git clone https://github.com/klkkeio/music-sheet-enhancer.git
cd music-sheet-enhancer
npm install
```

### 2. Command-Line Usage (CLI)

```bash
# Default: Faithful 1:1 clean restoration (no extra descriptions)
node bin/cli.js --data data/note-step-on-staff.json --out dist/note-step-on-the-staff --pdf

# Optional Reference Key with note letters underneath
node bin/cli.js --format clean-reference --data data/note-step-on-staff.json --out dist/note-step-on-the-staff --pdf

# Kids Large-Print Workbook & Answer Key (when explicitly requested)
node bin/cli.js --format kids --lang zh-HK --pdf

# Verify dataset, stepwise intervals, and 1:1 scan comparison PDF
node bin/verify.js --data data/note-step-on-staff.json --scan sheets/scan.pdf --angle -1.33 --stepwise --compare --out .verify-tmp
node bin/verify.js --clean --out .verify-tmp

# Generate all formats in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan) with PDFs
node bin/cli.js --format all --lang zh-TW --pdf
```

### 3. CLI Options Reference

| Flag | Description | Default |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `-f, --format <type>` | `clean`, `clean-reference`, `kids`, `workbook`, `workbook-answers`, `single`, `single-answers`, `all` | `clean` |
| `-l, --lang <code>` | Culture / language code (`en`, `zh-TW`, `zh-HK`, `zh-CN`, `en-US`, etc.) | `en` |
| `-d, --data <file>` | Path to exercises JSON dataset | `data/note-exercises.json` |
| `-o, --out <dir>` | Destination directory | `dist` |
| `-t, --title <text>` | Sheet title override for `clean` / `clean-reference` | dataset or locale |
| `--pdf` | Compile directly to PDF via headless browser (Edge / Chrome) | `false` |
| `--no-html` | Delete HTML files after PDF generation | `false` |
| `--standalone` | Embed VexFlow inline for 100% self-contained offline HTML | `true` |
| `--locale-file <file>` | Path to a custom locale dictionary JSON file | `null` |
| `-h, --help` | Display help guide | |

## 🌐 Internationalization (i18n) & Adding Languages

### Built-in Languages
- `en` (English)
- `zh-TW` (繁體中文 - 台灣)
- `zh-HK` (繁體中文 - 香港)
- `zh-CN` (简体中文)

### Culture Auto-Negotiation
The resolver handles standard BCP 47 culture tags with automatic fallback:
- `en-US`, `en-GB`, `en-AU`, `en-CA` $\rightarrow$ `en`
- `zh-Hant`, `zh-Hant-TW` $\rightarrow$ `zh-TW`
- `zh-Hant-HK`, `zh-MO` $\rightarrow$ `zh-HK`
- `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hans-CN`, `zh-SG` $\rightarrow$ `zh-CN`

### Extending to New Languages
To add a new language (e.g. Japanese, Spanish, German):
1. Copy `locales/en.json` to your own JSON file (e.g. `ja.json`).
2. Translate the values.
3. Pass it via the CLI:
   ```bash
   node bin/cli.js --lang ja --locale-file ./ja.json --pdf
   ```
   Or register it programmatically:
   ```javascript
   const { registerLocale } = require('music-sheet-enhancer');
   registerLocale('ja', require('./ja.json'));
   ```

## 🤖 Using AI Agents (Workflow, Self-Verification Loop & Installation)

### Skill vs. Legacy Workflows (Google Antigravity)
In Google Antigravity, standalone `.agents/workflows/*.md` files are deprecated—modern **Agent Skills** (`skills/<name>/SKILL.md`) replace them by providing **slash commands (`/music-sheet-enhancer`)**, **automatic intent discovery**, and **bundled verification scripts (`bin/verify.js`, `src/verifier.js`)** in one unit.

### Installing / Updating the Skill in Antigravity
- **Run directly inside this repository**: Antigravity discovers `skills/music-sheet-enhancer/SKILL.md` automatically when this repository is open after running `npm install`.
- **Standalone / workspace-only install in another project**: Copy `skills/music-sheet-enhancer/SKILL.md` into `<your-project>/.agents/skills/music-sheet-enhancer/SKILL.md`, copy `bin/`, `src/`, `locales/`, `data/`, and `package*.json` into `<your-project>/.agents/skills/music-sheet-enhancer/scripts/`, and run `npm install` inside that `scripts/` folder.
- **Global install (via `agents-treasure` vendored catalog)**:
  ```powershell
  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\update-vendored-skill.ps1 -Skill music-sheet-enhancer
  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\scripts\install-agents.ps1
  ```
  *(Then run `npm install` once inside `skills\music-sheet-enhancer\scripts\` so `sharp` is available globally for scan strip cropping.)*

### How to Ask an AI Agent to Run the Full End-to-End Loop
To prevent note-reading hallucinations on blurry scans, instruct the AI Agent to execute the **Two-Stage Delivery + Closed Verification Loop** below:

1. **Extract & Crop from `x = 0`**: Deskew the scan and crop full-width staves without cutting off clefs, margin numbers, Note 1, or end barlines (`node bin/verify.js --scan ...`).
2. **Transcribe + Domain Math Gate**: Record pitch keys in JSON (`docs/EXERCISE_SCHEMA.md`) and run `node bin/verify.js --data ... [--stepwise]` to catch wrong counts or unexpected pitch leaps.
3. **Build Clean Edition First + 1:1 Stacked Visual Loop**: Generate `--format clean` (zero student boxes/tips/extra labels) and `compare_all.pdf` (`--compare`), inspect every stave note-by-note top-vs-bottom, and **loop until 100% exact**. Generate `--format kids` or `--format clean-reference` **only if explicitly requested**.
4. **Final Deliverable PDF Check + Cleanup**: Inspect the final PDF in `dist/<slug>/`, run `npm test`, delete temporary verification files (`node bin/verify.js --clean`), and report only directly verified facts.

```text
   - Step B: Transcribe to JSON and validate schema, note counts, and pitch intervals via `bin/verify.js`.
   - Step C: Build the clean PDF and stacked `compare_all.pdf` (`--compare`), inspect every stave note-by-note against the raw scan, and loop fixing JSON until 100% identical.
3. Final Check & Cleanup: Inspect the final output PDF visually, run `npm test`, run `bin/verify.js --clean` to delete all temporary scripts/images, and report only verified counts, note sequences, and file paths.
```

# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |

## Security Model & Protections

`music-sheet-enhancer` follows secure coding and input validation best practices:

1. **Defensive Input Sanitization & XSS Prevention**:
   - All user-supplied fields (titles, exercise categories, note letters, student names) are sanitized with HTML entity escaping before injection into SVG/HTML templates.
   - Note keys are validated against strict scientific pitch notation grammar (`^[a-gA-G][b#]?\/[0-8]$`).
   - Clefs are restricted to a whitelist (`treble`, `bass`).

2. **Safe File System Operations**:
   - CLI file path inputs (`--data`, `--out`, `--locale-file`) are resolved using Node's standard `path.resolve` without executing dynamic shells.
   - No untrusted code execution or eval expressions.

3. **Zero Leaked Secrets & Minimal Dependencies**:
   - The runtime relies exclusively on `vexflow` with zero untrusted native binaries.
   - Continuous security vulnerability monitoring via `npm audit --audit-level=high` in CI.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a potential security vulnerability in this repository, please report it responsibly:

- Please open a private GitHub Security Advisory at: https://github.com/klkkeio/music-sheet-enhancer/security/advisories/new
- Alternatively, contact the maintainer via GitHub issues for security contact details.
- Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Reports are reviewed promptly and addressed in the next patch release.

# Music Sheet Enhancer - Data Schema Guide

This document describes how to structure exercise and clean score datasets for the `music-sheet-enhancer` engine.

---

## Dataset Formats

`music-sheet-enhancer` accepts **either**:
1. **A Document Wrapper Object** (recommended for faithful clean restorations — preserves document `title` and automated verification flags):

```json
{
  "title": "Note Step On the Staff",
  "stepwise": true,
  "exercises": [
    {
      "id": 1,
      "clef": "treble",
      "category": "mixed",
      "finger": "1",
      "expectedCount": 25,
      "notes": [
        { "key": "c/4", "letter": "C", "solfege": "do" },
        { "key": "d/4", "letter": "D", "solfege": "re" }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": 7,
      "clef": "bass",
      "leftLabel": "3",
      "endBarType": "end",
      "expectedCount": 24,
      "notes": [
        { "key": "g/2", "letter": "G", "solfege": "sol" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

2. **A Plain Exercises Array** (legacy format used by `data/note-exercises.json`):

```json
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "clef": "treble",
    "category": "lines",
    "notes": [
      { "key": "e/4", "letter": "E", "solfege": "mi" },
      { "key": "g/4", "letter": "G", "solfege": "sol" }
    ]
  }
]
```

---

### Document Wrapper Fields (Object Form)

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|:---|:---|:---:|:---|
| `title` | String | No | Sheet header rendered at top in `--format clean` and `--format clean-reference` |
| `subtitle` | String | No | Optional metadata subtitle |
| `stepwise` | Boolean | No | When `true`, `bin/verify.js` asserts every consecutive note step is `±1` diatonic degree |
| `exercises` | Array | Yes | Array of stave exercise objects |

### Stave / Exercise Object Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|:---|:---|:---:|:---|
| `id` | Integer | Yes | Stave number (`1`, `2`, `3`...) |
| `clef` | String | Yes | `"treble"` or `"bass"` |
| `category` | String | No | `"lines"`, `"spaces"`, or `"mixed"` |
| `title` | String | No | Exercise heading used by `--format workbook` / `kids` |
| `subtitle` | String | No | Exercise subheading used by `--format workbook` / `kids` |
| `finger` | String | No | Starting fingering marking rendered below/above note 1 in `clean` editions |
| `leftLabel` | String | No | Section label rendered in left margin beside the clef in `clean` editions |
| `endBarType` | String | No | `"single"` (default) or `"end"` (thick double final barline) |
| `expectedCount` | Integer | No | Expected note count checked by `bin/verify.js` |
| `notes` | Array | Yes | Non-empty array of note objects |

### Note Object Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|:---|:---|:---:|:---|:---|
| `key` | String | Yes | Scientific pitch in VexFlow format (`step/octave`) | `"c/4"`, `"f#/5"`, `"bb/3"` |
| `letter` | String | Yes | Note letter name rendered on answer/reference keys | `"C"`, `"F#"`, `"Bb"` |
| `solfege` | String | No | Solfège syllable displayed on `workbook-answers` | `"do"`, `"fa"`, `"si"` |

---

## Pitch Reference Guide

### Treble Clef (高音譜號 / 右手)
- **Lines (bottom to top):** `e/4` (E), `g/4` (G), `b/4` (B), `d/5` (D), `f/5` (F)
- **Spaces (bottom to top):** `f/4` (F), `a/4` (A), `c/5` (C), `e/5` (E)

### Bass Clef (低音譜號 / 左手)
- **Lines (bottom to top):** `g/2` (G), `b/2` (B), `d/3` (D), `f/3` (F), `a/3` (A)
- **Spaces (bottom to top):** `a/2` (A), `c/3` (C), `e/3` (E), `g/3` (G)
